$comment: The canonical Juno agent session protocol: one vocabulary for a coding or agent session, whichever engine runs it (the Swift runtime on a Mac, runner/agent-core in the cloud) and whichever surface shows it. Hand-authored; everything else is generated from it by scripts/generate-agent-protocol.mjs — runner/agent-core/src/protocol.generated.ts, src/lib/agent-protocol/protocol.generated.ts and native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoAgentProtocol/Generated/JunoAgentProtocol.swift — and `npm run agent:protocol:check` fails on drift. Rules: a minor version only ever adds (an event, a command, an optional field, an enum value); a reader skips an event type it does not know and reads an enum value it does not know as `unknown`, which is why every enum lists one. Field types: string, integer, number, boolean, timestamp (ISO-8601 string), json (any JSON value), enum:<Name>, type:<Name>, array:<type>. Keys on the wire are exactly the field names here, in every language. Golden transcripts live in contracts/agent/fixtures; every reducer of this protocol must fold each one to its .folded.json.

values.summary: On the machine showing it.
On one of the reader's own computers, driven from another device.
On a cloud runner against a repository.
A target this reader does not know.

PermissionMode.summary: How much the agent may do before it has to ask. Swift maps its four internal modes onto these at the edge.

values.summary: Read and search only; every change is refused.
Every edit and every command asks first.
Edits inside the workspace proceed; commands still ask.
Most actions proceed; the most dangerous still ask.
A mode this reader does not know.

ReasoningEffort.summary: How hard the model was asked to think. Absent means no thinking parameter was sent.

values.summary: The least thinking the provider offers.
Light thinking.
Moderate thinking.
Deep thinking.
Deeper than high, where the provider offers it.
The most the provider offers.
An effort this reader does not know.

SessionState.summary: What a session is doing, as one fact a list or a header can show.

values.summary: Nothing is running; the session waits for a message.
A turn is in progress.
Blocked on an approval decision.
Blocked on an answer to a question.
Finished what it was given. Terminal for a one-shot run.
Stopped because something went wrong.
Ended before it finished, without anyone asking: a crash, a quit, a lost host.
Stopped because somebody asked it to.
A state this reader does not know.
A message the reader sent.
An instruction sent while the previous turn ran, taken at its next step.
A message queued behind a running turn, started when it ended.
A hook that asked the agent to keep going.
A message sent from another device.
A routine that fired.
An origin this reader does not know.
The model finished its answer.
The turn reached its step limit.
The model reached its output limit.
Somebody stopped it.
The model declined.
A hook ended the run.
A reason this reader does not know.

UserDelivery.summary: How a user message reached the agent.

values.summary: As the message that starts a turn.
Into a running turn, before its next step.
Held until the running turn ended.
A delivery this reader does not know.

ToolKind.summary: What kind of thing a tool call does. The Agent Client Protocol's kinds, so a bridge to it is a rename.

values.summary: Reads a file or a directory.
Creates, changes, moves or deletes a file.
Runs a command.
Searches files or code.
Reaches the network: a web fetch or a web search.
Plans, delegates or records state without touching the workspace.
Anything else: an MCP tool, the screen, a test runner.
A kind this reader does not know.

Risk.summary: How dangerous an action is. The Swift runtime's five tiers; agent-core's safe/edit/command/sensitive map onto read/write/execute/destructive.

values.summary: Reads or searches inside the workspace.
Creates or changes files inside the workspace.
Runs a command whose effects stay in the workspace.
Reaches the network or runs arbitrary code, inside the workspace.
Escapes the workspace or cannot be undone.
A tier this reader does not know.

ToolResultStatus.summary: How a tool call ended. Typed, so no reader ever parses an outcome out of a display string.

values.summary: It ran and succeeded.
It ran and failed: a non-zero exit, a missing file, a refused write.
It never ran because an approval, a rule or the mode refused it.
It never ran: the turn was steered or stopped before its turn came.
It may have run and nobody knows how it ended: the host went away mid-call.

OutputChannel.summary: Which stream a chunk of live output came from.

values.summary: Standard output.
Standard error.
The host's own log line about the call.
A channel this reader does not know.
It did not exist before.
Its contents changed.
It no longer exists.
It was renamed or moved.
A change this reader does not know.

SubagentStatus.summary: Where a delegated agent is in its life. The raw values are agent-core's and the Swift runtime's, character for character.

values.summary: Accepted, waiting for a slot.
Its session and tools are being built.
Working.
Blocked on an approval.
Finished its task.
Could not finish.
Stopped by somebody.
The process ended before it did.
A status this reader does not know.

ApprovalDecision.summary: The answer to an approval request. The Agent Client Protocol's option names, plus redirect.

values.summary: This action, this once.
This action, and every one the saved rule matches from now on.
Not this action.
Not this action; do this instead (the feedback says what).
A decision this reader does not know.

ApprovalResolver.summary: Who or what answered an approval. A cloud run's automatic answer is recorded as `mode` rather than written as a person's.

values.summary: A person answered.
A saved permission rule answered.
The permission mode answered, with nobody asked.
A hook answered.
Nobody answered in time.
The host answered for its own reasons: the session ended, the request went stale.
A resolver this reader does not know.

PlanStepStatus.summary: Where one step of a plan or todo list stands.

values.summary: Not started.
Being worked on.
Done.
Cannot move without something else.
Dropped.
A status this reader does not know.

PlanDecision.summary: The answer to a proposed plan.

values.summary: Go ahead and carry it out.
Do not carry it out.
A decision this reader does not know.

NoticeSource.summary: Who a quiet note in the transcript is from.

values.summary: A project hook stepped in or failed.
The agent runtime itself.
The machine running the session: a setup step, a clone, a push.
A source this reader does not know.
The session's own model.
The runtime's bounded fallback notes.
A source this reader does not know.

ErrorCode.summary: What class of failure an error is, so a reader can decide what to offer without reading the message.

values.summary: The account's plan limit was reached.
The provider throttled the request.
The provider was overloaded or unavailable.
The conversation no longer fits the model's context.
A tool failed in a way the turn could not recover from.
The host lost its connection.
Stopped by somebody.
Anything else.
A code this reader does not know.

UsageScope.summary: Whose model calls a usage report counts.

values.summary: The session's own turn.
A delegated agent's calls (the envelope's agentId says which).
The call that summarised older turns.
A scope this reader does not know.

CommandDisposition.summary: Where a command stands at the host.

values.summary: Stored, not yet claimed.
A host has it and is acting on it.
Done.
The host refused it; errorCode says why.
Nobody claimed it before expiresAt.
Withdrawn by its sender.
A disposition this reader does not know.

RepositoryRef.summary: A repository a cloud session works on.

owner.summary: The owner, as the forge names it.

baseRef.summary: The branch the work starts from.

message.summary: What went wrong, for a person.

retryable.summary: Whether trying the same thing again could succeed.

Usage.summary: Model usage. Every count is what the provider reported; nothing is estimated.

cacheReadTokens.summary: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

cacheWriteTokens.summary: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

reasoningTokens.summary: The part of outputTokens spent thinking, when the provider says.

costMicroUsd.summary: What these calls cost, in millionths of a US dollar, when the producer knows.

PlanStep.summary: One step of a plan or todo list.

id.summary: Stable for the life of the plan.

QuestionOption.summary: One offered answer to a question.

envelope.summary: Every event carries these keys, beside its own.

v.summary: The protocol version the producer wrote, "<major>.<minor>". A reader refuses a major it does not know.

id.summary: Unique per event and stable across retries: readers drop an id they have already applied.

sessionId.summary: The session this event belongs to.

seq.summary: 1-based and increasing within one producer's stream of a session. Order, not identity; the id is the identity.

at.summary: When it happened, at the producer.

turnId.summary: The turn it belongs to. Absent means the turn that is open, if any.

agentId.summary: The delegated agent it belongs to. Absent means the session's own agent.

session.created.summary: A session began. The first event of every transcript.

workspaceName.summary: The folder's display name. Never an absolute path.

repository.summary: The repository, for a cloud session.

effort.summary: The thinking level it starts with.

mode.summary: The permission mode it starts with.

title.summary: Its title, when it has one.

session.configured.summary: What the next turn runs with. Only the fields that are set changed.

reason.summary: Why, when there is more to say than the state.

turn.started.summary: A turn began. Carries the turnId every event of the turn may name.

summary.summary: What it did, in a sentence, when the producer has one.

turn.failed.summary: A turn ended because something went wrong.

turn.interrupted.summary: A turn ended without finishing and without failing: a stop, a quit, a lost host. Any tool call still running has an unknown outcome.

transcript.restarted.summary: The transcript was rewound. A reader drops every turn and item it holds and rebuilds from the events that follow.

rewoundToTurnId.summary: The turn the session was rewound to, which is no longer in the transcript.

text.summary: What they wrote, as they wrote it (attachments are not inlined).

commandId.summary: The command that carried it, so the sender can mark it delivered.

item.assistant_text.delta.summary: More of the agent's reply. Appended to the item's text.

item.assistant_text.summary: The whole of one reply. Replaces whatever the deltas built.

item.thinking.delta.summary: More of the model's visible thinking. Appended to the item's text.

itemId.summary: The thinking block this belongs to.

item.thinking.summary: A summary of the model's thinking. Replaces whatever the deltas built. Never raw private chain of thought.

item.tool_call.summary: The agent called a tool. The call is running until its tool_result arrives.

itemId.summary: The provider's call id, stable for the call.

toolName.summary: The tool's own name (bash, run_command, read_file, …).

toolKind.summary: What kind of thing it does.

title.summary: One line for a person: `$ npm test`, `Read src/app.ts`.

inputSummary.summary: A bounded, redacted summary of the input. Never a whole file.

item.tool_output.summary: A chunk of a running call's live output.

exitCode.summary: The process's exit status, when it ran one.

output.summary: The tail of its output, bounded and redacted.

path.summary: Relative to the workspace. Never an absolute path.

patch.summary: A unified diff, bounded. Absent means none was sent, never that the change was empty.

checkpointId.summary: The checkpoint taken before it, which an undo names.

toolItemId.summary: The tool call that made it.

command.summary: The command that ran the tests.

testsRun.summary: How many ran, when the runner said.

failures.summary: How many failed, when the runner said.

item.subagent.summary: A delegated agent's state, sent whenever it changes. The latest one wins.

itemId.summary: The agent's id, stable for its life.

title.summary: What it was asked to do, in a few words.

activity.summary: What it is doing right now.

usage.summary: Its own model usage so far.

item.compaction.summary: Older turns now reach the model as a summary. The transcript keeps them; only what the model is sent shrank.

requestedByUser.summary: Whether the reader asked for it.

item.notice.summary: A quiet line the reader is owed: a hook stepped in, a setup step ran, the context was folded.

approval.requested.summary: The agent is waiting for a yes or a no.

itemId.summary: The tool call it is about.

action.summary: The tool or action, by name.

summary.summary: What would happen, for a person: the command, the path.

digest.summary: SHA-256 of the exact action, so an answer can only approve what was shown.

suggestedRule.summary: The rule allow_always would save, in Tool(pattern) grammar.

feedback.summary: What to do instead, with redirect; why, with deny.

question.asked.summary: The agent asked the reader something and is waiting.

options.summary: Offered answers, when it is a choice.

multiSelect.summary: Whether more than one option may be chosen.

plan.updated.summary: The whole todo list, as it now stands. Each snapshot replaces the last.

plan.proposed.summary: In plan mode, the agent proposes what it would do and waits for a decision before changing anything.

plan.resolved.summary: A proposed plan was approved or rejected.

usage.updated.summary: Model usage incurred since the producer's previous usage report. Readers add them up.

model.summary: The model the calls went to.

session.error.summary: Something went wrong that the reader should see. Whether the turn goes on is said by the turn events, not here.

code.pull_request.summary: Code extension: a cloud run pushed a branch, and opened or reused a pull request.

prUrl.summary: The pull request, when there is one.

reused.summary: Whether it already existed and this run added to it.

commandEnvelope.summary: Every command carries these keys, beside its own. A command may be delivered more than once; the host acts on an idempotencyKey once.

v.summary: The protocol version the sender wrote.

idempotencyKey.summary: Stable across retries of the same intent.

expiresAt.summary: After this the host must not act on it, and reports it expired.

turn.send.summary: Start a turn with a message. Refused while a turn runs; steer or queue instead.

turn.steer.summary: Give the running turn an instruction, taken before its next step.

turn.queue.summary: Hold a message until the running turn ends, then start a turn with it.

digest.summary: The digest that was shown, so a stale answer cannot approve a changed action.

feedback.summary: With redirect, what to do instead.

plan.decide.summary: Approve or reject a proposed plan.

session.set_mode.summary: Change what the next turn runs with. The host caps a remote sender at its own ceiling.

receipt.summary: What a host reports about a command.
